say:1:1611318001:0.text: Everyone, settle down. Listen carefully, and I promise you'll stay safe. Cooperation... that's the real key here.
say:1:1611318001:0.source_cn: 虽然你是魔物，但我知道你能听懂我的话，这是来自心灵层面...

say:2:1611318002:1.text: Hypofiend, yes, I can tell you understand me. You're not angry, are you? Just... lonely. Misunderstood.
say:2:1611318002:1.source_cn: 停下吧，大家伙，不要愤怒，不要攻击。你的身体在颤抖——...

say:3:1611318003:1.text: You don't seek destruction. You seek to be seen. To be respected. These young ones aren't here to judge you. They're simply watching... waiting to see who you'll choose to be.
say:3:1611318003:1.source_cn: 真正的力量不是毁灭，而是“被看见”。你看我旁边这些年轻...

say:4:1611318004:1.text: Give me your anger. Your pain. I won't seal you away or strike you down like others would. I'll show the world what you can become. And <style="highlight">that's how everyone wins</style>.
say:4:1611318004:1.source_cn: 来，把你的痛苦交给我。我不封印你，也不毁灭你，我会让大...

say:5:1611318005:1.text: Something stirs in your mind—but before you can grasp it, Esten continues.
say:5:1611318005:1.source_cn: 不知为何，你的脑海中瞬间闪过了一丝奇异的感受，但尚未等...
say:5:1611318005:1.male: Something stirs in your mind—but before you can grasp it, Esten continues.
say:5:1611318005:1.female: Something stirs in your mind—but before you can grasp it, Esten continues.

say:6:1611318006:1.text: Yes, exactly. Trust me completely. Lay down your anger—it's poisonous. Let it go.
say:6:1611318006:1.source_cn: 全心全意地信任我、跟随我吧，大家伙。来，按照我说的做—...

say:7:1611318007:1.text: The Hypofiend growls... then slowly lowers its head. The students gasp.
say:7:1611318007:1.source_cn: 那只魔物低吼了一声，乖乖地低下头，垂下双臂。周围的学生...
say:7:1611318007:1.male: The Hypofiend growls... then slowly lowers its head. The students gasp.
say:7:1611318007:1.female: The Hypofiend growls... then slowly lowers its head. The students gasp.

say:8:1611318008:0.text: That's right. Treat others kindly, and they'll return the same. If you understand, nod.
say:8:1611318008:0.source_cn: 没错，温良。他人待你会像你待他人。明白吗？明白的话就点...

say:9:1611318009:1.source_cn: 魔物很配合地点了点头。

say:10:1611318010:1.text: Tell me—will you raise violence again?
say:10:1611318010:1.source_cn: 现在你已经找到了内心的平静。用你的方式告诉我，以后还会...

say:11:1611318011:1.text: After a long pause, the Hypofiend shakes its head.
say:11:1611318011:1.source_cn: 魔物呆愣了一下，摇了摇头。
say:11:1611318011:1.male: After a long pause, the Hypofiend shakes its head.
say:11:1611318011:1.female: After a long pause, the Hypofiend shakes its head.

say:12:1611318012:1.text: Remember this peace. Remember that we are not your enemy—and you are not ours.
say:12:1611318012:1.source_cn: 很好，就是这样！记住你现在内心的感受，让安宁喜乐的情绪...

say:13:1611318013:1.text: The Hypofiend scratches its head. The fearsome creature now seems almost harmless. Esten pats it gently, then turns to the crowd.
say:13:1611318013:1.source_cn: 魔物挠了挠头，在旁观者的眼中，它居然变得有些憨傻了起来...
say:13:1611318013:1.male: The Hypofiend scratches its head. The fearsome creature now seems almost harmless. Esten pats it gently, then turns to the crowd.
say:13:1611318013:1.female: The Hypofiend scratches its head. The fearsome creature now seems almost harmless. Esten pats it gently, then turns to the crowd.

say:14:1611318014:0.text: As you've just seen, Hypofiends are lost souls—not monsters. When we understand instead of reject, conflict fades. Compassion turns even the fiercest into something gentle.
say:14:1611318014:0.source_cn: 看到了吗？所谓“魔物”，不过是被悲伤困住的灵魂。当你用...

say:15:1611318015:0.text: Remember this, my young friends. The strength of the soul surpasses even the greatest magic.
say:15:1611318015:0.source_cn: 记住了，我的朋友们：心灵的力量，有时比魔法更锋利。

say:17:1611318016:0.source_cn: 感谢您的教导，尊敬的大导师。

say:18:1611318017:1.text: Come. Let's take our friend somewhere safe.
say:18:1611318017:1.source_cn: 走吧，我们带着这个大家伙离开这里。

say:20:1611318018:1.text: Esten leads the Hypofiend out of the gallery. The students remain behind, stunned and whispering.
say:20:1611318018:1.source_cn: 埃斯特大导师带着魔物，在学生们惊讶纷纷的议论声中，被信...
say:20:1611318018:1.male: Esten leads the Hypofiend out of the gallery. The students remain behind, stunned and whispering.
say:20:1611318018:1.female: Esten leads the Hypofiend out of the gallery. The students remain behind, stunned and whispering.

say:21:1611318019:0.source_cn: 休惊讶地睁大了眼睛，你和娑丽丝对视一眼，都皱起了眉头，...
say:21:1611318019:0.male: Silven is speechless. You glance at Solise—her raised eyebrow mirrors your disbelief.
say:21:1611318019:0.female: Silven is speechless. You glance at Solise—her raised eyebrow mirrors your disbelief.
